source_witness_caveat: Both mobile ports preserve the directional neighbor-selection graph and per-direction zero selector cases but have different layouts and rendering details. Native Windows instructions establish position/color copies and zero-versus-one helper-result branches. The baseline carried edge-a value was initialized to zero and reset after every allocating block, so the new local explicit-zero branch preserves that value contract. Helpers and their order are unchanged in the retained source. Native equality does not prove original variable names or a unique authored spelling. No linked image, data placement or runtime equivalence is claimed.
